name: GlassIcons-TS-TW
blurb: Icon buttons in frosted glass cards that rotate and lift on hover.
description: A grid of icon buttons rendered as frosted glass cards with 3D depth effects using CSS transforms and backdrops. On hover, the background rotates and lifts while a label fades in below the icon.
use_when: Showcasing a set of actions or features with a modern glassmorphic aesthetic and visual hierarchy.
avoid_when: Space is constrained or users need rapid repeated interactions.
a11y: Buttons include aria-labels; visual label appears on hover only, not on keyboard focus.
